I know standards are different in different states but in my state every high school student takes a minimum of 1 finance class.  Obviously if a kid isn’t paying attention during the class, which happens frequently, they aren’t going to absorb the information.  But it’s not like it’s some illuminati secret the credit cards are trying to trick you.  At some point it’s common sense that if you spend money you haven’t earned you’re going to have to pay it back to whoever paid it for you.  

Obviously there are TONS of predatory lenders out there and when it comes to young people if their parents don’t teach them they are put in bad position.  Not to mention strait up scams.
